'''2018 European Championship Day 2 Koen Meijssen LS Old Allies''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Koen Meijssen]] at [[2018 European Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Koen Meijssen]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 European Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Old Allies / We Need Your Help|V4-L-oldallies.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-european-championships/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210127125624/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-european-championships/ Internet Archive]
